climate_zones.name: Hot-Humid
climate_zones.description: Covers the southeastern US (FL, LA, coastal TX, SC, GA coastal). Hot summers with high humidity, mild winters. Cooling loads dominate; moisture control and mold prevention are critical.

climate_zones.name: Hot-Dry / Mixed-Dry
climate_zones.description: Covers the desert Southwest (AZ, NV, NM, inland CA, UT lowlands). Hot summers with very low humidity, cool winters. Cooling dominates; dust and UV exposure are primary concerns.

climate_zones.name: Mixed-Humid
climate_zones.description: Covers mid-Atlantic and parts of the South and Midwest (VA, NC piedmont, KY, TN, MO, IN, OH, KS, OK). Hot summers and cold winters with moderate humidity throughout the year.

climate_zones.name: Cold / Very Cold
climate_zones.description: Covers much of the northern US (MN, WI, MI, ND, SD, NE, IA, NY, PA, ME, NH, VT, MA, CO mountains, WY). Cold winters with significant snowfall; heating dominates; insulation and weatherization are key.

climate_zones.name: Subarctic / Arctic
climate_zones.description: Covers Alaska. Extreme cold winters with permafrost concerns. Heating is paramount; structures must account for freeze-thaw cycles and frozen ground.

climate_zones.name: Marine
climate_zones.description: Covers the Pacific Coast (coastal WA, OR, northern CA). Mild, temperate year-round with wet winters and dry summers. Moisture intrusion, mold, and rot are primary concerns.

climate_zones.name: Oceanic (Pacific Coast)
climate_zones.description: Covers coastal British Columbia. Mild, wet winters and warm, dry summers. Moisture management and roof condition are critical maintenance priorities.

climate_zones.name: Cold Continental (Prairies)
climate_zones.description: Covers Alberta, Saskatchewan, and Manitoba. Very cold winters with low humidity, hot dry summers. Heating systems and insulation require rigorous maintenance.

climate_zones.name: Humid Continental (Central & Eastern Canada)
climate_zones.description: Covers Ontario and Quebec. Cold winters with significant snowfall, hot and humid summers. HVAC, roof, and foundation maintenance are all critical.

climate_zones.name: Maritime (Atlantic Canada)
climate_zones.description: Covers New Brunswick, Nova Scotia, PEI, and Newfoundland. Mild but wet and foggy. High precipitation requires vigilant roof, gutter, and moisture maintenance.

climate_zones.name: Subarctic / Arctic (Northern Territories)
climate_zones.description: Covers Yukon, Northwest Territories, and Nunavut. Extreme cold; permafrost is a factor. Heating infrastructure and structural integrity in freeze-thaw cycles are primary concerns.

climate_zones.name: Tropical
climate_zones.description: Covers northern Queensland and the Northern Territory. Hot and wet summers (monsoon), warm dry winters. Cyclone preparedness, humidity control, and corrosion prevention are key.

climate_zones.name: Subtropical
climate_zones.description: Covers southeast Queensland and coastal NSW. Warm year-round with distinct wet and dry seasons. Roof, gutter, and pest management are critical priorities.

climate_zones.name: Semi-Arid / Arid
climate_zones.description: Covers inland Queensland, NSW, SA, and WA. Hot, dry summers with low rainfall. Dust management, water conservation, and heat protection are key concerns.

climate_zones.name: Temperate
climate_zones.description: Covers Victoria, SA, ACT, and southern NSW. Mild year-round with cool, wet winters and warm summers. Balanced maintenance across HVAC, roof, and landscaping.

climate_zones.name: Mediterranean
climate_zones.description: Covers the Perth region of Western Australia. Hot, dry summers and mild, wet winters. Fire risk during summer, moisture management in winter.

climate_zones.name: Cool Temperate / Alpine
climate_zones.description: Covers Tasmania and alpine regions of Victoria and NSW. Cool to cold year-round with significant rainfall. Insulation, heating, and moisture protection are priorities.

climate_zones.name: Oceanic (Temperate Maritime)
climate_zones.description: The dominant UK climate across England, Wales, and much of Scotland. Mild, wet, and overcast year-round with no extreme seasonal temperature swings. Moisture, damp, and mold are the primary home maintenance concerns.

climate_zones.name: Highland
climate_zones.description: Covers the Scottish Highlands and elevated areas of Wales. Cooler, wetter, and windier than lowland UK. Snow is common in winter; insulation and roof integrity are critical.

climate_zones.name: Continental (Eastern England)
climate_zones.description: Covers parts of eastern England (East Anglia, Lincolnshire). Drier and with greater temperature extremes than the rest of the UK. Drought-related ground movement can affect foundations.

proposals.description: Full diagnostic of furnace rattling noise, cleaning, and repair of loose blower components.
proposals.scope: Inspect and diagnose rattling noise, tighten or replace loose blower wheel, clean heat exchanger, verify combustion and airflow, test all safety switches.
proposals.customerNotes: Price includes all labor and standard repair parts. Any major component replacements will be quoted separately before proceeding.

proposals.customerNotes: Ecobee is compatible with your existing Carrier system. Includes 3-year device warranty from Ecobee.
